title: Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

reading.body:
A retired couple lost $800,000 to a cryptocurrency scam that used a fake trading app with an AI-generated interface. The scammers created a false digital display showing investment gains while secretly taking the money, a form of fraud that exploited the couple's trust built through small initial trades and withdrawals they were allowed to make.

The failure was in the deployment of the fake interface without human verification of account activity or withdrawal requests. A human check at any point, either when reviewing the discrepancy between displayed gains and actual account balance or when processing large withdrawals, would have caught the fraud before most of the money disappeared.

Whether the AI-generated fake site was built specifically to deceive or repurposed from legitimate software is not established. The extent to which the scammers relied on AI rather than simpler deception methods remains unclear.

reports.title: Georgia couple loses $800K in sophisticated cryptocurrency scam
Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

summary:
A retired Georgia couple lost nearly their entire life savings of $800,000 in a sophisticated cryptocurrency scam that started when a stranger contacted Jerry Dunaway through WhatsApp. The scammer convinced Jerry to invest using a mobile trading app, gradually building trust by allowing him to make small trades and withdraw modest amounts. Unknown to Jerry, the scammers had created a fake digital interface that showed false investment gains while concealing their actual theft of his money.

The couple discovered the fraud last week when Jerry tried to withdraw additional funds and was unable to access his account, prompting him to call police. Gwinnett County investigators confirmed the app was real but the account display was manipulated through an AI-generated fake site. Jerry and Mindy Dunaway are now speaking publicly to warn others about the scammers' sophisticated tactics. Police say victims in these cases rarely recover their stolen funds. The couple's children have created a GoFundMe page to help them cover living expenses while they work with authorities.
